Phase 5 diagnostic-only design
- no production source changes
- no PostgreSQL polling observer during timed workload
- OFF -> ON -> OFF -> ON zero-SQL tracer calibration
- one diagnostic first-run/precondition is excluded from warm-tail statistics only
- collect at least 40 warm runs; after 40 stop if >=5 genuine P99>500ms failures, otherwise continue to 60
- bounded in-memory tracing; dump only after each run
- preserve all run results, top-20 per run, global top-100, recovery timing, task submit/start timing, local process scheduling counters
